aggregators.name: Glasser
aggregators.what_it_is: A single-account gateway that resells paid data endpoints from specialist providers (SEO, people/company, web, places, market data) to AI agents. The agent searches a catalog, inspects an endpoint's schema and price, then executes it as a billed Run against one workspace balance.
aggregators.billing_model: Pay-per-call from a prepaid workspace balance; no per-provider subscriptions. Search and Inspect are free; each Run is charged (flat, per-result with cap, per-token with cap, or base+per-result), with separate charge rules for NO_RESULT, PROVIDER_ERROR, TIMED_OUT and INTERNAL outcomes. Every new workspace starts with a signup Grant of free balance.
aggregators.free_credit: Every new workspace starts with a signup Grant of free balance.

aggregators.name: Monid
aggregators.what_it_is: An aggregation gateway where an agent discovers, inspects and runs third-party data endpoints at runtime through one key and one wallet, instead of signing up with each provider. Exposed as an HTTP API, MCP server, CLI and agent Skill, with an optional x402 crypto payment path.
aggregators.billing_model: Pay-as-you-go from a prepaid wallet, no subscriptions or contracts: per-call flat fee or per-result fee with an optional base fee. Discover and inspect are free; runs are billed. New accounts start with $1 in free credit. Alternatively, runs can be paid per-call on-chain in USDC via x402 with no workspace balance at all.
payment_methods: crypto/x402 (USDC on Base mainnet or Monad mainnet)
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: Minimum price: $0.01. Monid raises the advertised price to this floor if the run's quote is lower.
aggregators.free_credit: New accounts start with $1 in free credit.
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 1,700+ tools across 55+ providers (homepage); the docs site states "1,800+ tools & APIs"

aggregators.name: Apify Store
aggregators.what_it_is: A marketplace of hosted scrapers and automation programs called Actors, each callable as a REST job that returns structured data. One Apify account and token reaches every Actor, and agents can also connect over a remote MCP server or pay per run without an account using x402 or Skyfire.
aggregators.billing_model: Free plan renewing $5/month of prepaid usage credit, plus paid monthly plans ($19 Starter / $199 Scale / $999 Business) that add pay-as-you-go usage. Each Store Actor is priced by its developer as pay per event, pay per usage (compute units), or both. Free-plan access pauses when the monthly credit runs out instead of billing.
aggregators.free_credit: Free plan renewing $5/month of prepaid usage credit, plus paid monthly plans ($19 Starter / $199 Scale / $999 Business) that add pay-as-you-go usage.

aggregators.name: RapidAPI (Nokia API Hub)
aggregators.what_it_is: A long-running public API marketplace, now branded Nokia API Hub, where one account key proxies requests to thousands of third-party APIs listed by their publishers. Each API is subscribed to separately on a monthly plan, so the single key unifies auth and billing but not entitlement.
aggregators.billing_model: Per-API recurring monthly subscription plans (many with a free BASIC tier) plus overage fees per call above a plan's quota; invoices under 50 US cents roll into an account balance until the threshold is passed. Free APIs need no card, pay-per-use and freemium APIs do.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: New: Starting December 2025, each subscription will include 10 GB of bandwidth per billing cycle at no cost. After that limit, a fee of $1 per additional 1 GB of traffic will apply, calculated proportionally based on total usage. This fee will be charged to the consumer and helps cover infrastructure costs, keeping the platform reliable and scalable for everyone.
aggregators.free_credit: Per-API recurring monthly subscription plans (many with a free BASIC tier) plus overage fees per call above a plan's quota
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: No count stated on the pages read; the homepage describes itself as "more than just a catalog for APIs"

aggregators.name: Agentic Market (Coinbase x402 Bazaar)
aggregators.what_it_is: Coinbase's public catalog of x402-enabled services, readable by agents over a plain REST endpoint and by humans in a browser. It is a discovery index rather than a reseller: there is no account or key, and the agent pays each service directly per request in USDC over the x402 protocol.
aggregators.billing_model: No platform account or subscription. Discovery via GET /v1/services and GET /v1/services/search?q={query} is open; each listed service sets its own per-request price, settled on-chain in USDC when the client answers an HTTP 402 challenge.
payment_methods: crypto/x402 (USDC, observed settling on Base and Solana)

aggregators.name: API.market
aggregators.what_it_is: A marketplace that proxies third-party APIs and AI models through its own gateway, handling auth, billing, rate limiting and analytics so one account key reaches every subscribed product. Each listed API is also exposed as an MCP server for agents.
aggregators.billing_model: Per-product plans in two shapes: monthly prepaid subscriptions with an included call quota plus per-call overage (hard or soft limit), or pay-as-you-go with no monthly fee billed cumulatively every 10 minutes. Most APIs offer a free trial with no credit card required.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: API.market only charges for successful API calls.
aggregators.free_credit: Most APIs offer a free trial with no credit card required.

aggregators.name: APILayer
aggregators.what_it_is: A first-party suite of data APIs (aviation, finance, geolocation, email validation, news, weather, scraping) sold under one account and one key, rather than a third-party reseller marketplace. All products share a single base URL pattern and the same query-parameter auth.
aggregators.billing_model: One account and key across the catalog, with per-API plans; a free plan is available on every API.
aggregators.free_credit: a free plan is available on every API.
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 40+ Production-Ready APIs (homepage); the docs hub states "each of the thirteen APIs documented in this hub"

aggregators.name: Eden AI
aggregators.what_it_is: An AI gateway that routes to many LLM and specialist-model vendors (OCR, speech, vision, translation) through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, key and credit balance. Scope is AI models rather than general data APIs.
aggregators.billing_model: Pay-as-you-go from prepaid credits with no subscription, 7 requests/second by default (upgradable to 15 on request) and auto-refill available; every API response returns the exact USD cost. A sandbox token allows free testing. An Advanced AI Platform tier with custom pricing and bulk discounts is sold by sales.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: Eden AI charges no markup on provider pricing. You pay exactly what the underlying provider charges, plus a 5.5% platform fee applied at checkout.
aggregators.free_credit: A sandbox token allows free testing.
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 500+ AI models from 50+ providers (docs index); the homepage states "around 1,000 LLMs and expert models across 50+ providers"

aggregators.name: Flatkey
aggregators.what_it_is: An OpenAI-compatible router that resells hosted LLMs from many model vendors alongside a catalog of pay-per-call tools, all behind one key and one prepaid balance. Primarily a model gateway rather than a general data-API marketplace.
aggregators.billing_model: Usage-based per-token/per-call pricing drawn from one prepaid balance covering both models and tools; the docs also describe subscription plans chosen at signup. Failed Flatkey-side calls are charged $0.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: API prices are at least 20% below the official API list price for the same model.
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 100+ official AI models and 1,000+ pay-per-call tools

aggregators.name: OpenRouter
aggregators.what_it_is: An LLM router that fronts hundreds of models from many inference providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint and key, adding fallbacks, routing and cost tracking. Models only, no third-party data APIs.
aggregators.billing_model: Pay-as-you-go per token from prepaid credits. Models with the :free variant cost nothing but are rate limited per day, and buying credits raises the limit. Bring-your-own-key usage above the free allowance is charged a percentage of the equivalent OpenRouter cost.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: We pass through the pricing of the underlying providers without any markup
aggregators.rate_limits: Models with the :free variant cost nothing but are rate limited per day
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: "hundreds of AI models through a single API endpoint" — no numeric count given on the pages read
aggregators.visibility_note: LLM router aggregator; set aside with LLM APIs 2026-11-24, restorable.

aggregators.name: treg
aggregators.what_it_is: A third-party intermediary that resells per-call access to many third-party tool and data APIs through its own token and base URL, billed from a prepaid balance. SkeletonKey lists it as a catalog entry, not as a recommended access layer: hold your own vendor accounts and keys where you can, rather than routing everything through one gateway key.
aggregators.billing_model: Metered per call from a prepaid balance, at cost with 0% markup stated; a new verified account gets a one-time free credit of $1.00. treg publishes no single per-call price across its catalog.
aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: States 0% markup: calls are billed "at cost" from the prepaid balance (treg's own skill.md, read 2026-10-28).
aggregators.free_credit: a new verified account gets a one-time free credit of $1.00.
aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 4,000+ tools across 119 providers (treg.to/catalog: "4,064 endpoints across 113 platforms and 119 providers", read 2026-10-28)

aggregators.name: x402scan
aggregators.what_it_is: A third-party explorer and analytics dashboard for x402 traffic that also presents itself as a marketplace of paid agent-callable services. Listed here as a lead only: its own pages would not render for this check, so none of its claims are confirmed.

aggregators.name: Zyla API Hub
aggregators.what_it_is: An API marketplace that proxies a large catalog of data, finance, weather, validation and AI APIs through one gateway and one key. Agents can reach the whole catalog over Zyla's MCP server and be billed per successful call, while developers subscribe per API from their own code.
aggregators.billing_model: Two paths from one account: pay-per-call through the Zyla MCP server (no subscription, no minimum, charged only on successful calls, requires a credit card on file or the agent receives a 402 payment link), or per-API monthly subscription plans with a fixed call quota and a 60/120/240 requests-per-minute cap. Most APIs offer a 7-day free trial of up to 50 calls, usable once per account.
aggregators.free_credit: Most APIs offer a 7-day free trial of up to 50 calls, usable once per account.
aggregators.rate_limits: per-API monthly subscription plans with a fixed call quota and a 60/120/240 requests-per-minute cap
